event_chain.summary: Ransom/encryption notice on district laptops; services shut down

summary: On October 21, 2026 Richmond Public Schools in Virginia shut down internet, phone and email services after a confirmed cybersecurity incident, disrupting teaching tools, attendance, Chromebooks and classroom boards while schools stayed open. Employees saw messages on district laptops, titled as a data breach and encryption notice, saying the network and sensitive information had been compromised and threatening to publish stolen data unless the district made contact. The district had not confirmed data theft or named an attacker, and said it would offer identity monitoring to students and staff whose information may have been affected.
